[ota-hal] OTA-1725 — the card pays what the fight pays

Audit item F3, and it is the same defect as OTA-1708 wearing different clothes.

⚠⚠⚠ THE ITEM CARD READ ONE FIELD AND THE FIGHT READ ANOTHER. `previewArmor`
printed `a.statBonus` — the single legacy field — while `effectiveStats` sums
`statBonuses ?? (statBonus ? [statBonus] : [])`. Two different rules over two
fields that disagree on most of the catalog, so the card was not a summary of
the piece; it was a summary of a field.

MEASURED OVER ALL 288 STAT-BEARING ARMOUR ROWS:

    repeat the primary inside statBonuses ......... 204
    REPLACE it with something else ................  54
    rows hiding at least one paid bonus .......... 185

The Aetheric Crown of the Giants grants CHA+3, STR+2 and HP+40. The card said
"CHA +3". The Reclaimer's Salvage Cap authors `statBonus: wisdom+1` and grants
`investigation+1` — the card named a stat the fight does not pay at all.

After, from the same rows:

    Crown ......... AC +4 · Resists: aetheric, slashing, cold · CHA +3 · STR +2
                    · HP +40 · Regen: +1 stamina per action · Durability: 65
    Salvage Cap ... AC +1 · INT +1 · Durability: 20
    rows that PAY something 288 · still hiding a paid bonus 0

⚠⚠ ONE AUTHORITY, NOT A THIRD FORMATTER. The either/or expression was written
out THREE times in equipment.ts and a FOURTH, different rule lived in the
preview. Adding a fifth would have been the actual bug again. `armorBonusList`
is the expression, once; `armorPaidBonuses` is the half the game actually pays;
the engine summation, `armorHpBonus` and the card all read the same function, so
the card cannot promise what the fight does not grant.

⚠ AND IT CANNOT OVER-PROMISE EITHER. `add()` filters to STAT_KEYS and hp is paid
through hpMax, so a `constitution` / `acrobatics` / `aetheria` entry has no
PlayerCharacter field and grants nothing. `armorPaidBonuses` drops those, so the
card errs in neither direction. My first pass printed the raw label and produced
"INV +1" for a row that canonicalises to intelligence; it goes through
`canonicalStatKey` now, so the card names the stat the sheet will show.

⚠ ACCESSORIES DELIBERATELY UNTOUCHED. `previewAccessory` UNIONS the two fields,
which is a different rule — and the right one there: of 42 accessory rows 39 are
single-only, and the 3 multi rows EXCLUDE the primary rather than repeating it.
Applying the armour rule would have deleted a bonus from each of those three.
Two catalogs, two authoring conventions, measured separately. Collapsing them to
one function would have been tidier and wrong.

⚠ `??` IS EITHER/OR, NOT A UNION — for the third time now (OTA-1708, OTA-1725,
and the mistake this OTA nearly made). A union here would have doubled 204 rows
and resurrected 54 retired values.

Full surface clean: 1185 suites, 12323 tests, 0 failures. 18 gates green.
